// diagnostic

E3301

`{api}` is not available in a freestanding build.

What

`{api}` is not available in a freestanding build.

Why

`--freestanding` targets have no OS; only `core`-level APIs are available.

Fix

Embed data at compile time with `@embed("file")`, or build without `--freestanding`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3301: tests/ui/freestanding_e3301.stderr.

Error [E3301]: `files.read` is not available in a freestanding build.

  5 |     _ :: fs.read("config.txt")
    |             ^^^^
 Why: `--freestanding` targets have no OS; only `core`-level APIs are available.
 Fix: embed the data at compile time with `@embed("file")`, or build without `--freestanding`.
